headline: As of 2026-10-24: 25,724,364 early/mail ballots cast nationally across 47 of 50 states, D+11.7 cast-ballot lean.
bullets: 25,724,364 early/mail ballots cast so far across 47 states reporting.
Across party-registration states, ballots cast lean D+11.7 by registration.
Most ballots cast: Texas (3,503,734), California (2,758,100), Florida (2,348,834).
